# visionOS

Every app in this list that runs on visionOS. That is 15 apps with 8 for Plex and 13 for Jellyfin and 6 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [A Playa Named Gus](https://github.com/eslutz/A-Playa-Named-Gus) - iPhone and Vision Pro player with an immersive viewing space. `Jellyfin` · `iOS` `visionOS` · `Open source`
- [Aurora for Plex](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6547867554) - Apple Vision Pro client. `Plex` · `visionOS`
- [CineDepth](https://www.reddit.com/r/VisionPro/comments/1vhjxm1/cinedepth_my_2dto3d_video_app_now_supports/) - Vision Pro player that converts 2D video to 3D. `Plex` `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `visionOS` · `Free`
- [Convolution](https://github.com/illixion/Convolution) - Spatial media app for Vision Pro, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Mac. `Jellyfin` · `macOS` `iOS` `iPadOS` `tvOS` `visionOS` · `Open source` `Free`
- [Infuse](https://firecore.com/infuse) - Video player for Apple devices with library browsing and an optional Pro tier. `Plex` `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `macOS` `iOS` `iPadOS` `tvOS` `visionOS` · `Freemium` · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/infuse/id1136220934)
- [Jelly Shark](https://github.com/axeslasher/Jelly-Shark) - Apple TV and Vision Pro client. `Jellyfin` · `tvOS` `visionOS` · `MIT` `Free`
- [JellyTV](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752357290) - Video client for Apple devices. `Jellyfin` · `macOS` `iOS` `iPadOS` `tvOS` `visionOS` `watchOS` · `Freemium`
- [Labstream](https://github.com/jlipworth/Labstream) - Vision Pro-first player that also runs on iPhone and iPad. `Plex` `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `iOS` `iPadOS` `visionOS` · `GPL-3.0` `Beta`
- [NAS Media Viewer](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nas-media-viewer/id6759468790) - Vision Pro, iPhone and Mac player that also opens SMB shares. `Plex` `Jellyfin` · `macOS` `iOS` `visionOS` · `Subscription`
- [Reel (cj-vana)](https://github.com/cj-vana/reel-client) - Client for Apple devices, the web and desktops, with experimental TV builds. `Jellyfin` · `Windows` `macOS` `Linux` `Web` `iOS` `iPadOS` `tvOS` `visionOS` · `MIT` `Free`
- [Screenlit](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/screenlit/id6499478407) - Vision Pro player for MV-HEVC, side-by-side 3D, VR180 and 360 video. `Plex` `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `visionOS` · `Paid`
- [Suite Browser](https://www.reddit.com/r/VisionPro/comments/1wnddw0/suite_7_brings_virtual_projection_and/) - Apple Vision Pro browser with virtual projection that plays from media servers. `Plex` `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `visionOS`
- [ThisFrame](https://github.com/THISJOWI/THISFRAME) - Native client for iPhone, Mac, Apple TV and Vision Pro. `Jellyfin` · `macOS` `iOS` `tvOS` `visionOS` · `MIT` `Free`
